content.title: Mizuho initiates Viking Holding at Underperform citing full valuation
content.summary: Investing.com -- Mizuho initiated coverage of Viking Holding with an Underperform rating and $54 price target, saying the stock’s premium pricing leaves limited upside despite the company’s high-quality operations. The brokerage said Viking’s valuation already reflects its unique river and ocean cruise model, leaving few catalysts for re-rating.

content.title: Carnival earnings, demand: Cruise lines having 'more than' a moment
content.description:
Cruise line operator Carnival (CCL) beat earnings estimates for its fiscal third quarter, but its stock fell Monday despite the company also raising its annual profit forecast.

Citi Leisure & Travel Analyst James Hardiman comes on Market Catalysts to discuss Carnival's guidance and the cruise industry's resilient consumer demand.

content.title: Cruise line stocks fall amid concerns over promotional activity
content.summary: Investing.com -- Carnival Corporation (NYSE:CCL) stock fell 3.2% on Friday, leading a broader decline in cruise line shares amid growing concerns about increased promotional activity in the sector. Royal Caribbean Cruises (NYSE:RCL) dropped 2.7%, Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NYSE:NCLH) declined 1.7%, and Viking Holdings (NYSE:VIK) slipped 2.5%.
